response.rationale: The item is a clearance item marked final_sale == True, which triggers RET-012 (priority 100), the highest-priority applicable rule. Final-sale items cannot be returned or exchanged, and this dominates the standard 30-day window (RET-007). The defective rule (RET-020) does not apply because it requires final_sale == False and defective is null. No goodwill grant or other overriding exception is present.
